name: mirage
text: Novig streaming is still built (the engine reads Novig's websocket and holds up to 2,000 markets live), but it only works with the engine's Novig read key. Without a key that Novig accepts, the engine falls back to the public routes (about 2 prices a second, no stream), which is why scans take 11 minutes now. Your 08:56 screenshot shows the new key was sent 4 minutes ago, after the runner I restarted had already started. I've just restarted the engine again so it picks up the new pair. I'll check the route in a few minutes and tell you whether the stream is back.
